keywords: EIP-8053 合约边界 gas 单位
EIP-8425 量子冻结与账户恢复
summary: ChainSecurity 报告两天后，修复方案成形。LukaszRozmej 的 PR 让状态 gas 退还和回滚只记入储备，`gas_left` 在帧内永不增加，并加入 legacy share，让新建存储槽从执行 gas 里仍按 Osaka 价格扣费；同一机制也写入 EIP-8141。另有 PR 提出 RESERVOIR 操作码让合约看到储备余额。EIP-8425 量子冻结与账户恢复合并为草案。

items.topic: 修补 EIP-8037 的 gas 回流
items.title: PR 12581：状态 gas 退还记入储备并加入 legacy share
items.note: （LukaszRozmej，同时修改 EIP-8037 和 EIP-2780）针对 ChainSecurity 文章的问题：
items.title_en: PR 12581: credit state gas refills to the reservoir and add a legacy share
items.note_en: (LukaszRozmej, editing both EIP-8037 and EIP-2780) targets the problems in the ChainSecurity article:

items.topic: 修补 EIP-8037 的 gas 回流
items.title: EIP-8141：把 EIP-8037 的 legacy share 作为额外执行 gas 收取
items.note: （LukaszRozmej），否则 frame 交易里被调方用约 12,100 执行 gas 就能写冷新槽。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: charge the EIP-8037 legacy share as extra execution gas
items.note_en: (LukaszRozmej); otherwise a callee in a frame transaction could write a cold new slot with about 12,100 execution gas.

items.topic: 修补 EIP-8037 的 gas 回流
items.title: 新 EIP：RESERVOIR 操作码
items.note: （ja7ad），0x4d，返回当前帧的 `state_gas_reservoir`（frame 交易里是剩余 `state_gas_left`），与 `GAS` 配合可以测量含状态 gas 的净消耗。
items.note_en: (ja7ad), 0x4d, returning the current frame's `state_gas_reservoir` (the remaining `state_gas_left` in frame transactions); used with `GAS`, it lets contracts measure net consumption including state gas.

items.topic: 修补 EIP-8037 的 gas 回流
items.title: EIP-8053：合约边界上用 gas 单位
items.note: （LukaszRozmej）。原草案让 `GAS` 返回 milli-gas，而调用参数和 stipend 仍是 gas，`gasleft() - 5000`、`gasleft() < x / 63` 这类代码会差 1000 倍；修改后 milli-gas 只留在 EVM 内部。
items.title_en: EIP-8053: gas units at the contract boundary
items.note_en: (LukaszRozmej). The draft had `GAS` return milli-gas while call arguments and the stipend stayed in gas, which would make code like `gasleft() - 5000` or `gasleft() < x / 63` off by a factor of 1000; after the change, milli-gas stays inside the EVM.

items.title: 新 EIP：量子冻结与账户恢复
items.note: 合并（colinlyguo，EIP-8425），提出冻结旧 ECDSA 授权、恢复未迁移账户的最小框架，源自 Magicians 关于 Q-day 冻结与恢复的讨论。
items.title_en: New EIP: quantum freeze and account recovery
items.note_en: Was merged (colinlyguo, EIP-8425), proposing a minimal framework for freezing legacy ECDSA authorization and recovering unmigrated accounts, building on a Magicians discussion about freezing and recovery for Q-day.

items.title: EIP-8425：明确 ecRecover 移除语义
items.note: 合并，规定调用旧地址时的账户状态、普通调用语义、空返回数据和 EIP-2929 访问计费；明确恢复范围和账户访问规则 合并。
items.note_en: Was merged, defining account state, ordinary call semantics, empty return data and EIP-2929 access accounting for calls to the old address; clarify recovery scope and account access rules was also merged.

keywords_en: EIP-8053 gas units at the contract boundary
EIP-8425 quantum freeze and account recovery
summary_en: Two days after the ChainSecurity report, a fix took shape. A PR from LukaszRozmej credits state gas refills and rollbacks only to the reservoir, so `gas_left` never increases within a frame, and adds a legacy share so a new storage slot still costs its Osaka price in execution gas; the same mechanism goes into EIP-8141. Another PR proposes a RESERVOIR opcode so contracts can see the reservoir balance. EIP-8425 quantum freeze and account recovery was merged as a draft.
